description: Tide forecast verification: compares tide_astro, tide_nbm and tide_blend forecasts against prelimtide observations. Bias, MAE, RMSE, ensemble coverage and lead-time diagnostics. Internal use only.

panels.title: Verification metrics by model
panels.description: Bias = AVG(forecast − observed); MAE = AVG(|err|); RMSE = sqrt(AVG(err²)); In-env = fraction of observations inside the ensemble bounds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model AS "Model",
       COUNT(*)                              AS "N",
       AVG(error)                            AS "Bias (ft)",
       AVG(ABS(error))                       AS "MAE (ft)",
       SQRT(AVG(error*error))                AS "RMSE (ft)",
       AVG(in_envelope::float) FILTER (WHERE forecast_lb IS NOT NULL) AS "In-envelope"
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'tide'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY model

SELECT date_trunc('day', "timestamp") AS "time",
       model AS metric,
       AVG(ABS(error)) AS mae
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'tide'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT date_trunc('day', "timestamp") AS "time",
       model AS metric,
       AVG(error) AS bias
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'tide'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT lead_bucket,
       AVG(ABS(error))::float AS mae
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'tide'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY lead_bucket
ORDER BY CASE lead_bucket WHEN 'astro' THEN -1 WHEN '0-6h' THEN 0 WHEN '6-12h' THEN 1 WHEN '12-24h' THEN 2 WHEN '24-48h' THEN 3 WHEN '48-72h' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

panels.title: Forecast vs Observed (scatter) — $model
panels.description: Each point is a matched (forecast, observation) pair for the selected model. Perfect forecasts fall on the y=x diagonal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_value, forecast_value
FROM v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'tide'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND group_id = '$group'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
  AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")

WITH r AS (
  SELECT LEAST(MIN(observed_value), MIN(forecast_value)) AS mn,
         GREATEST(MAX(observed_value), MAX(forecast_value)) AS mx
  FROM v_forecast_verification
  WHERE variable = 'tide'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND group_id = '$group'
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND lead_bucket IN ($lead_bucket)
    AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
)
SELECT g::float AS identity_x, g::float AS identity_y
FROM r, generate_series(r.mn::numeric, r.mx::numeric, GREATEST((r.mx - r.mn) / 100.0, 0.01)::numeric) g
